input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including ali pay async response, invoke request, request params field, response params field. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, cos manager, daily check in. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage ali pay async response records, so that I can track and organize ali pay async response data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage invoke request records, so that I can track and organize invoke request data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage request params field records, so that I can track and organize request params field data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage response params field records, so that I can track and organize response params field data effectively.
